findings.message: `proj.analytics.Orders` is partitioned by `order_date`, but the query doesn't filter on it. BigQuery rejects queries on this table unless a filter on `order_date` can limit the partitions.
findings.fix: Add a filter on `order_date`, for example `order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.

findings.message: `LIMIT 10` doesn't reduce the bytes billed: selecting `*` reads every column of `proj.analytics.Orders` in the partitions the query touches.
findings.fix: Select only the columns you need. For column names and types, use `scanisaur_schema_describe`, which reads no data.
